Phase 55 implementation @ 7fd0f1a (branch phase/measure-the-loop), per approved plan r3.
What/where:
- tagteam/report.py (new): phase_report/render_text/report_command. Cycle counts (rounds, change requests, bounces, amendments, escalations), gate runs/seconds from gates (decided only), elapsed turn spans per role from entry ts (unknown when the start entry isn't a hand-off), wall clock + implementation-before-first-submit, stored consumption (cost keys stripped), turn coverage (target rule → owed-state rule for null targets only → round-1 lead unknown; panel verdicts only panel rows; four-way token status + separate non_ok_rows; unattributed rows), rate limits as last signal inside the span.
- db.py: schema v10 (usage.model_usage_json, target_phase/type/round, additive ALTER); connect_for_read (read_only_connect(require_current_schema=False) → (conn|None, note)); table_columns; column-tolerant get_usage with target_phase= and parsed model_usage.
- cycle.py: keyword-only conn= on read_status/read_rounds (+ DB helpers, caller's conn not closed) and FILES_ONLY sentinel.
- headless.py: sanitize_model_usage/model_usage_json (four token fields, ≤16 models, name ≤128); _record_usage writes TurnIdentity target; non-dict modelUsage no longer drops the usage record. panel.py writes target (sub phase/type/round); briefer/lead_chat pass model_usage_json.
- usage.py: --by role|cycle|model|kind (repeatable, replaces default blocks; default JSON shape unchanged), cost dropped from text (kept in --json), connect_for_read; exit 2 with one line when rows exist but the DB is unreadable without writing (WAL without index).
- cli.py: report dispatch + READ_ONLY_COMMANDS + summary + help. cockpit.js/hub.js: cost column, tooltip cost and $ chip removed. README, data/workflows.md + docs/workflows.md paragraph; roadmap; phase doc Implementation notes (deviations: interjection counts omitted; usage exit 2 on unreadable DB).
Verification: new tests/test_report.py (21: full-data counts/times, owed-state coverage, v10 target, cross-phase start, dual-selection dedupe, panels, failed rows, invariant on every fixture, degraded data, files-only + v9 projects in ordinary AND read-only mode with tree snapshot/user_version unchanged, CLI read command, JS assets), tests/test_usage.py (9), plus test_db v10 (5), test_headless sanitize + impl-start target identity, test_cycle conn/FILES_ONLY, test_panel lens target, test_readonly snapshot matrix adds report and the usage wal-only refusal. Focused files passed while working; full suite: see gate entry @ 7fd0f1a.
Real-data check: `tagteam report --phase legacy-diagnostics` matches hand-computed Phase 53 timestamps and gate durations (numbers in phase doc Implementation notes); repo DB stayed user_version 9.

Reviewed implementation e7d1706 against approved plan r3. Gate accepted: 1932 passed, 5 skipped at e7d1706. Focused reviewer run: tests/test_report.py + tests/test_usage.py, 30 passed; no full-suite rerun. Read-only connection plumbing, target-aware row selection, model capture and cost removal look sound. Two changes remain:

1. Correct human-ruling and repeated-verdict attribution (tagteam/report.py:175-218, also counts/timing). cycle.add_ruling stores human rulings as role=reviewer with the same round and the [ARBITER RULING by ...] content prefix; parser.py already recognizes that prefix. _coverage currently counts those entries as workflow turns, contrary to the plan, and credits the same usage rows twice. Focused reproduction: lead SUBMIT r1, reviewer ESCALATE r1, human REQUEST_CHANGES ruling r1, one reviewer usage row -> turns=3, matched=2, and row_ids=[1] on both reviewer entries. Expected: two agent turns, one matched reviewer turn; the human ruling is not a reviewer request or a reviewer-time span (it may still end the phase or hand work back to the lead). Exclude rulings from agent-turn coverage and reviewer-request counts while preserving their state-transition significance. Add an actual ruling-shaped fixture. Also handle genuine same-round reviewer re-entry after NEED_HUMAN -> rule answer -> reviewer verdict: phase/type/round/role cannot distinguish those separate turns. Do not reuse the same candidate rows to assert both are exactly matched; report ambiguous coverage as unknown when available evidence cannot disambiguate, and test this case.

2. Restore the approved interjection measurement. The implementation notes drop it because interjections live in a separate table, but the approved plan explicitly includes interjections where present and the project already has db.get_interjections(phase=..., cycle_type=...). Read the available project-owned rows through the same read-only connection, expose the count per cycle/phase in JSON and text, and report unavailable rather than zero when the table/DB is absent. Test nonzero counts, isolation from other phases and missing-table fallback. This is finishing approved scope; no new external data source or approval flow is needed.

The documented usage exit-2 behavior for an unreadable database is reasonable. The project-only-data and other arbiter rulings remain honored.

Phase 55 implementation round 3 @ a43b370 — both reviewer round-2 findings, tagteam/report.py only (+ tests, phase doc notes).
1. Rulings and re-entry: _is_ruling (reviewer seat + cycle.RULING_PREFIX) / _is_agent_turn. Rulings are excluded from coverage turns, change_requests/escalations counts and reviewer time spans, and counted as `rulings` (text "N arbiter ruling(s)"); a REQUEST_CHANGES ruling can still start a lead span. Repeated agent turns sharing (type, round, role): when candidate rows exist every such turn is `unknown` with row_ids [] and ambiguous_row_ids listed (non_ok 0, invariant intact); with no rows they stay `unmatched`. Tests use the real API: init → ESCALATE → cycle.add_ruling(REQUEST_CHANGES) + one reviewer row → turns 2, reviewer matched with row_ids [1], change_requests 0, rulings 1, one reviewer span (your reproduction); NEED_HUMAN → cycle.rearm(reviewer) → REQUEST_CHANGES same round + two reviewer rows → both reviewer turns unknown with ambiguous_row_ids [1, 2], matched 0; same shape without rows → unmatched.
2. Interjections: read through the same read-only connection via db.get_interjections(phase=P) when the table has phase/type; per-cycle `interjections` and phase-level `interjections` in JSON, text "N interjection(s)" or "interjections unavailable"; None (not 0) with no DB, no table, or an unreadable table shape. Tests: nonzero per cycle (impl 2, plan 1) with another phase's note excluded (phase total 3); 0 when the table exists but is empty; None without a DB and with a schema-v3 DB that has no interjections table.
Verification: tests/test_report.py 27 passed locally; full suite: see gate entry @ a43b370.
